mentions.name: NotesPlus
mentions.description: A free note-taking app for macOS (Silicon and Intel) and Windows that stores every note as a local Markdown file. It supports tags and priorities, renders many scientific syntaxes (mhchem, TeX/LaTeX, Excalidraw, PlantUML, Graphviz/DOT, Vega-Lite, and Markdown footnotes), can display notes in vertical lanes like JIRA, and offers free iCloud sync. Currently in early alpha.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an Apple Notes clone, but everything is a local Markdown file.
Currently free, macOS (Silicon + Intel) and Windows. Has tags and priorities, can display many scientific syntaxes (mhchem, most TeX / LaTeX stuff, Excalidraw, PlantUML, Graphviz / DOT, Vega-Lite, and actual Markdown footnotes). Can show notes in vertical lanes like JIRA does. Free iCloud sync too. Still early alpha.

mentions.name: NotesPlus
mentions.description: A note-taking app styled like Apple Notes where every note is a local Markdown file, with a goal of reading any form of files. Built as a hobby summer project for Second Brain users and Markdown hoarders who found existing tools like Notes, Obsidian, Bear, and Typora insufficient.
mentions.problem: Existing note apps (Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Typora) didn't come close to what the author personally wanted in a notes app.
mentions.audience: Second Brain people and Markdown hoarders
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an Apple Notes clone, but everything is a local Markdown file.
Still in development, started as a hobby summer project for Second Brain people and Markdown hoarders like me. Goal is to be able to read any form of files.
